text.zh-TW: 註冊時輸入推薦碼 K1AL1R，結帳現折；限時領取，未註明金額與結束日期。取自平台分享文案；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Enter referral code K1AL1R when registering; discount at checkout. Limited-time, with no amount or end date stated. From the share text; official terms prevail.

steps.en: Select “Sign up”: this site copies the referral code and opens the PK 雙饗卡 app download page.

steps.zh-TW: 下載並開啟 PK 雙饗卡 App，以新會員身分開始註冊。
steps.en: Download and open the PK 雙饗卡 app, then start registering as a new member.

steps.zh-TW: 註冊時輸入推薦碼 K1AL1R：可直接貼上，也可手動輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）。
steps.en: Enter referral code K1AL1R during registration: paste it, or type it in by hand exactly as shown, including capitalization.

steps.zh-TW: 依 App 指示領取肯德基與必勝客優惠券，結帳時使用；金額與期限以 App 與官方公告為準。
steps.en: Claim the KFC and Pizza Hut coupons as the app directs and use them at checkout; amounts and deadlines follow the app and official announcements.

intro.zh-TW: 必勝客與肯德基（KFC）的會員 App：依分享文案，新朋友註冊時輸入推薦碼 K1AL1R，可領優惠券，結帳現折。
intro.en: Pizza Hut and KFC member app: per the share text, new users who enter referral code K1AL1R can claim coupons for an instant discount at checkout.

description.zh-TW:
PK 雙饗卡是必勝客與肯德基在台灣共用的會員 App，在其中一個品牌累積的點數，兩個品牌都可以使用。本站的連結不含推薦碼：點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會複製推薦碼 K1AL1R，並開啟 App 下載頁。

下載並開啟 App 後，註冊時請貼上或手動輸入推薦碼。依平台分享文案，新朋友輸入推薦碼可領肯德基與必勝客優惠券，結帳現折；文案沒有寫金額與結束日期（只寫「限時領取」）。實際內容以官方公告為準。

本頁另外整理必勝客與肯德基的近期優惠代碼（見下方「近期優惠代碼」）：它們是點餐時輸入的折扣，和推薦碼是不同的東西。
description.en:
PK 雙饗卡 is the shared member app of Pizza Hut and KFC in Taiwan; points earned at one brand can be used at both. The link on this page does not carry the referral code: selecting “Sign up” copies code K1AL1R and opens the app download page.

After installing and opening the app, paste the code during registration, or type it in by hand. According to the platform's share text, a new user who enters the code can claim KFC and Pizza Hut coupons for an instant discount at checkout; the share text states no amount or end date and says only limited-time. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

This page also lists recent coupon codes for Pizza Hut and KFC (see “Current coupon codes” below). They are order-time discounts and not the same thing as the referral code.

notes.zh-TW:
推薦碼 K1AL1R 不在連結中，需在註冊時貼上或手動輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）；本站沒有實際註冊測試推薦碼是否被接受。優惠對象是新朋友，分享文案沒有寫優惠券金額與結束日期，也沒有提到邀請人的回饋，優惠可能隨時調整或結束。

官方網站另有新會員禮（限首次加入的會員於加入後 30 日內登入 App 領取），官方頁面沒有提到推薦碼，兩者是否相同或可同時使用不明，請以 App 與官方公告為準。

依會員條款（2024-08-01 施行），每人限申請一個帳號；無行為能力或限制行為能力的人（如未成年人）申請前須先取得法定代理人同意。優惠券限單次使用，不可兌換現金。

pkcardtw.app.link 是 PK 雙饗卡在第三方連結服務 app.link 上的專屬網域，app.link 本身不是 PK 雙饗卡的網域。短網址的終點可由擁有者變更，請在繼續前確認最終網址。

kfcclub.com.tw 與 pizzahut.com.tw 是肯德基與必勝客自己的網站（PK 雙饗卡官網的 Logo 連到它們），本頁優惠代碼的出處連結只會指向這兩個網域。
notes.en:
Referral code K1AL1R is not in the link, so paste it or type it in during registration exactly as shown, including capitalization. Nobody registered to test whether the code is accepted. The offer is for new users; the share text states no coupon amount or end date and mentions no reward for the referrer, and the offer may change or end at any time.

The official site lists a separate new-member gift for first-time members who log in to the app within 30 days of joining; its pages do not mention a referral code, so it is unclear whether it is the same as, or can be used together with, the code's coupons. The app and the official announcements prevail.

Under the member terms (effective 2024-08-01), each person may hold one account, and a person with no or limited legal capacity (for example a minor) needs a legal guardian's consent before applying. Coupons are single-use and cannot be exchanged for cash.

pkcardtw.app.link is a PK 雙饗卡 host on app.link, a third-party link service; app.link itself is not a PK 雙饗卡 domain. The destination of a short link can be changed by its owner, so check the final address before continuing.

kfcclub.com.tw and pizzahut.com.tw are KFC's and Pizza Hut's own websites (the logos on the PK 雙饗卡 official site link to them); the source links for the coupon codes on this page point only to these two domains.

q.zh-TW: PK 雙饗卡的推薦碼 K1AL1R 要在哪裡輸入？
q.en: Where do I enter PK 雙饗卡 referral code K1AL1R?

a.zh-TW: 依平台分享文案，在註冊 PK 雙饗卡 App 時輸入。本頁的連結不含這組推薦碼，點擊「立即註冊」時，本站會先複製推薦碼，再開啟 App 下載頁；請在註冊時貼上，或依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入。
a.en: Per the platform's share text, you enter it when registering in the PK 雙饗卡 app. The link on this page does not carry the code, so selecting “Sign up” first copies it and then opens the app download page; paste it during registration, or type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 輸入推薦碼可以領到什麼？有金額或期限嗎？
q.en: What do I get for entering the code, and is there an amount or deadline?

a.zh-TW: 依平台分享文案，新朋友輸入推薦碼可領肯德基與必勝客優惠券，結帳現折。分享文案沒有寫金額，只寫「限時領取」，沒有結束日期，本站也沒有找到官方對推薦碼活動的說明，所以本頁不列出金額與期限。實際內容以官方公告為準。
a.en: Per the platform's share text, a new user who enters the code can claim KFC and Pizza Hut coupons for a discount at checkout. The share text states no amount and says only limited-time, with no end date, and no official description of the referral offer was found, so no amount or deadline is listed here. Actual terms follow the official announcements.

q.zh-TW: 必勝客、肯德基的優惠代碼怎麼用？和推薦碼有什麼不同？
q.en: How do Pizza Hut and KFC coupon codes work, and how are they different from the referral code?

a.zh-TW: 優惠代碼是點餐時輸入的折扣組合；推薦碼 K1AL1R 是註冊 PK 雙饗卡時輸入、用來記錄推薦人的代碼，兩者不同，不能拿一個代替另一個。肯德基的代碼在肯德基官方優惠券頁輸入，必勝客的代碼在必勝客官方網站的「優惠券與代碼」頁輸入。本頁上方的「近期優惠代碼」列出現有代碼與效期：肯德基的代碼取自官方網站使用的優惠圖片，必勝客的代碼整理自第三方網站、未經必勝客官方核對，實際內容與價格以官方訂購頁為準。
a.en: A coupon code is a discounted bundle you enter when ordering; the referral code K1AL1R is entered when you register for PK 雙饗卡 to record who referred you. They are different and cannot stand in for each other. KFC codes are entered on KFC's official coupon page, and Pizza Hut codes on the “coupons and codes” page of Pizza Hut's official site. The “Current coupon codes” section above lists the codes and deadlines: the KFC code comes from an image used on the official site, while the Pizza Hut codes were compiled by a third-party site and have not been checked against Pizza Hut's official pages. The official ordering pages prevail for contents and prices.
